text_block_list.text: While out and about with King Halo—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Wait a moment.
That poster over there...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh~... Looks like they're holding an art exhibition.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Trainer, wanna go take a look? It seems like it's close by, too."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Right here! A spot like this is just what a King deserves!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate lady frequents first-rate places.
Like orchestral concerts, for instance.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "If you're King's Trainer, you should keep some first-class outing spots in mind."
choice_data_list: So you know about paintings and stuff?
Do you know about paintings and stuff?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: O-ho-ho-ho! Of course, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There is heartfelt emotion poured into
works crafted by a first-rate creator!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Look! Look at the art used for the poster!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Even if a painting looks messy at first glance,
you can really feel the landscape of the artist's heart!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"It must have been painted by a truly top-tier artist.
I wonder who painted it... Um..."

Taking a closer look at the exhibition poster
together with King Halo—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Kindergarten 'We Love Mom & Dad!' Exhibition"...
choice_data_list: There's definitely a lot of heart put into this.
There's definitely a lot of heart put into this.
Guess I'm no master painter after all, huh.
Guess I'm no master painter after all, huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Kindergarten 'We Love Mom & Dad!' Exhibition"...
choice_data_list: There's definitely a lot of heart put into this.
There's definitely a lot of heart put into this.
Guess I'm no master painter after all, huh.
Guess I'm no master painter after all, huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O... Ohohoho!
Isn't that right, isn't that just so!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Despite her young age, her love for her parents
shines through every part of it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It just goes to show that to parents,
their own child is always a master painter!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go check it out right away!
Admission is free—as expected of a first-rate venue!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I can just picture you drawing it with all your heart~ So adorable~... It's so heartwarming~...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fufu, an exhibition like this isn't bad at all.

And so, touring the art museum with King Halo
left me with a warm feeling in my heart.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
B-Being a first-rate painter
has nothing to do with whether you're famous or not!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Touching people's hearts
is what matters most for a top-tier star!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I was truly moved by this painting!
So there is no doubt it is first-class!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To think that doesn't reach you...
Come on, let's head inside and watch!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just look at your parents' faces as they gaze upon the painting!
They are the very picture of bliss!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's proof it truly touches people's hearts!
You make sure to learn the essence of being first-class too!

And so, touring the art museum with King Halo,
I had the meaning of "first-class" thoroughly drilled into me.
